item.title: [AMZN Bearish (-0.21)] CareCloud confirms massive data breach after 3.7M patients’ records stolen – What we know
item.description:
Sentiment: AMZN Bearish (-0.21)
CareCloud has confirmed a massive data breach that compromised the medical and personal records of over 3.7 million patients. The March cyberattack, which involved hackers accessing and removing data from CareCloud’s Amazon Web Services account, is now the fifth-largest US healthcare data theft of 2026. Stolen information includes names, addresses, Social Security numbers, medical records, government IDs, and financial details, leaving affected individuals vulnerable to identity theft and fraud.
